function readInput(value: Element): string | undefined {
  if (value instanceof HTMLInputElement) return value.value.toUpperCase();
}
function domStatics(): [1, string] {
  const fromPrototype: HTMLInputElement = HTMLInputElement.prototype;
  const input = new HTMLInputElement();
  new MutationObserver(records => { records.forEach(record => console.log(record.target.nodeName)); });
  return [Node.ELEMENT_NODE, fromPrototype.value || input.value];
}
console.log('done');
